rationale: Description: Sit on floor, back leaned against chair base (globalTilt=-60 semi-supine ✓ PRESERVED). Draw both knees up to chest (leftHip=112, rightHip=115 ✓ PRESERVED; leftKnee=138, rightKnee=138 deeply bent ✓ PRESERVED). Wrap both arms around shins, clasp hands. Drop chin down (rig-limited — no head pitch joint). Tip: round upper back slightly. Fixes: (1) spine -32→+15 (CRITICAL: forward round per tip, was backward arch); (2) shoulderFwdL/R -35→+50 (CRITICAL: cron-round-9 fix was WRONG direction — for supine pose, FORWARD in body-frame projects DOWN in world, pushing wrists AWAY from knees. Reversing to +50 (BEHIND) projects UP in world, bringing wrists UP toward knees); (3) leftElbow/rightElbow 100→120 (deeper bend, brings wrists together at centerline for clasp). PRESERVE: leftShoulder=55, rightShoulder=60 (INWARD across body for clasp), leftAnkle=-10, rightAnkle=-10 (already plantarflexed), hipAbductL=-8 hipAbductR=8 (slight asymmetry — minor, leave). neck=-28 (LEFT tilt — leave, gaze-away approximation). Result: lWr(-0.04,0.05,-0.01) rWr(-0.02,0.07,-0.05) — wrists CLASPED at centerline (|lWr-rWr|=0.044, only 4cm apart ✓) at hip level (y=0.05). Knees at y=0.42. Wrists 0.37m below knees. Rig-limited: cannot bring wrists UP to knee level while keeping them clasped (requires horizontal adduction joint, renderer lacks). Best approximation: hands clasped at hip level in front of body, arms reaching toward shins. Cron-round-9 fix verification: INCORRECT — shoulderFwd was set to WRONG sign (-35 FORWARD instead of +50 BEHIND), pushing wrists DOWN. This patch REVERSES the cron-round-9 fix.
